what_happened: Stack tunnel had intermittent 503s (~7-17%%) for 16 days from 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-23. Three decoy causes investigated and fixed first (duplicate launchd daemon on Mac Studio, http2 protocol flapping, stale ghost connector from Apr 9) — all real but secondary. Root cause: MacBook had sudo cloudflared service install run on 2026-04-08 with token pointing to the same tunnel UUID. Cloudflare edge load-balanced ~50/50 between Mac Studio (working) and MacBook (no backend services). Symptom: random 503s, no pattern, no errors in Mac Studio cloudflared logs.
what_learned: Multi-origin Cloudflare tunnels require every connector to run equivalent backend services. A backup connector without backup services is not redundancy — it is an active 50%% failure mode. Add a second cloudflared without bridge/SSE locally = ~50%% of traffic gets routed to a dead origin and returns 503. Mac Studio cloudflared metrics showed 0 origin errors throughout — the failures were never visible from the live origin side, which made detection hard.
